data: Do the box plots show a general increasing trend in P_k value as the number of inference iterations increases from 2 to 100?

The box plots show a general decreasing trend in P_k value as the number of inference iterations increases from 2 to 100. The median values decrease from approximately 0.035 at iteration 2 to around 0.028 at iteration 100. There is no significant increase in P_k value as the number of inference iterations increases. Therefore, the statement is incorrect.
